"""Main closes the b9 diagnostic, records every outcome, and retires redundant logs."""
from pathlib import Path
import fcntl
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json

B = Path('/home/yayoi/.local/state/strata-sycl/post-reboot-tuning-20261007')
W = Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/yqYo1/Strata/.worktree/sync-latest-updates-20261012')
F = W / 'bench/results/2026-10-13-xe-b9-update'
O = B / 'xe-llvm-v711-source-v5/direct_owner.py'
assert hashlib.sha256(O.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == 'a29d8257eecc77c4ad9ae6671d092b56f4c09a35c4247c125fed3a8c8bc1f95f'
s = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('xe_b9_retention_owner',O)
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(s)
s.loader.exec_module(m)

def dump(path, value):
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(json.dumps(value,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n')

def pin(path):
    return dict(path=str(path),sha256=m.sha(path),bytes=path.stat().st_size)

with (B/'owned-v0141-measurement.lock').open('a') as lock:
    fcntl.flock(lock,fcntl.LOCK_EX|fcntl.LOCK_NB)
    paths = sorted(B.glob('main-current-xe-b9-*/record.json'))
    paths += [B/'main-current-xe-b9-pristine-model-root-v1'/phase/'record.json' for phase in ['xe-startup','xe-model']]
    originals = []
    for p in paths:
        x=json.loads(p.read_text())
        assert x.get('active') is False, str(p)
        for c in x.get('commands',[])+x.get('guard_commands',[]):
            assert m.closed(c) and c['session_anchored'],str(p)+' '+c['label']
            for own in c.get('owners',[]):
                v=m.identity(own['pid'])
                assert not v or v['start_ticks']!=own['start_ticks'] or v['state']=='Z','original owned member still alive'
        originals.append((p,x))
    model_path=B/'main-current-xe-b9-pristine-model-root-v1/xe-model/record.json'
    new=json.loads(model_path.read_text())
    old_path=B/'latest-update-pristine-configured-model-root-v1/xe-model/record.json'
    old=json.loads(old_path.read_text())
    assert new['passed'] and new['complete'] and new['model_normal_close'] and new['kernel_gate_passed']
    assert old['passed'] and new['input']['sha256']==old['input']['sha256']
    nv,ov=new['validation'],old['validation']
    diff=next((i for i,(a,b) in enumerate(zip(nv['output_ids'],ov['output_ids'])) if a!=b),None)
    q=dict(source_revision='b9f00e9db7fd56decdd9930ee84049d980b904e4',engine_label='xe0.1.43',
           source_patch_applied=False,free_model_runtime_passed=True,all_runtime_fault_gates_passed=True,
           performance_eligible=False,controlled_diagnostic_samples=1,
           sample=dict(prompt_tokens=nv['prompt_tokens'],generated_tokens=nv['generated_tokens'],
                       prefill_ms=nv['engine_prefill_ms'],decode_ms=nv['engine_decode_ms'],
                       prefill_tps=nv['prompt_tokens']*1000/nv['engine_prefill_ms'],
                       decode_tps=nv['generated_tokens']*1000/nv['engine_decode_ms']),
           actual_info=new['effective_info'],actual_route=nv['actual_route'],normal_quit=True,
           reported_token_LP5_equivalence=nv['token_logprob_sha256']==ov['token_logprob_sha256'],
           matching_initial_tokens=diff if diff is not None else len(nv['output_ids']),
           whole_model_quality_qualified=False,full_context_runtime_qualified=False,restore_qualified=False,
           inference_port_adopted=False,
           decision='Official server ports retained. New Xe inference not promoted: this is one validation-enabled diagnostic with changed token/LP5 output, not matched repeated timing or quality qualification.',
           new_receipt=pin(model_path),historical_receipt=pin(old_path),
           followups=['Trace numerical differences before any new inference port.',
                      'Use at least32768 input for matched repeated model timing;64K after its independent admission.',
                      'Keep prefill/decode adoption independent; use multiple decode samples before comparing.',
                      'Official setup-default and parameter-optimized comparisons remain separate TODOs.',
                      'Free and contrib-llvm host tests pass; contrib-llvm whole-model GPU inference unverified.'])
    dump(F/'qualification.json',q)
    derivation_path=F/'receipt-derivations.json';d=json.loads(derivation_path.read_text())
    for p,x in originals:
        target=F/'receipts'/((p.parent.parent.name+'-'+p.parent.name if p.parent.name in ['xe-startup','xe-model'] else p.parent.name)+'.json')
        if target.exists():
            continue
        v=dict(x);v.pop('evidence',None)
        if 'result' in v and isinstance(v['result'],dict):
            v['result']={k:z for k,z in v['result'].items() if k!='files'}
        dump(target,v)
        d['receipts'].append(dict(original_path=str(p),original_sha256=m.sha(p),original_bytes=p.stat().st_size,
                                 public_path=str(target.relative_to(F)),public_sha256=m.sha(target),
                                 removed='Duplicate utility/health/model stdout/stderr and full successful license inventory; actual protocol/LP5, diagnostics, mappings, outcomes, commands, environment and owned closure retained.'))
    p=B/'main-current-xe-b9-startup-review-v1.json';dump(F/'startup-review.json',json.loads(p.read_text()))
    prior=F/'report-registry-v174.json';index=json.loads(prior.read_text());entries=[]
    for name in ['research-xe-b9-decode-port-candidates-round309-v1.txt','research-xe-b9-prefill-port-candidates-round310-v1.txt']:
        p=B/'research-20261009'/name;target=F/'research'/(name+'.json')
        dump(target,dict(original_path=str(p),sha256=m.sha(p),bytes=p.stat().st_size,text=p.read_text()))
        entries.append(dict(path=str(target.relative_to(F)),sha256=m.sha(target)))
    dump(F/'report-registry-v175.json',dict(research_completed=index['research_completed']+len(entries),
        prior=dict(path=prior.name,sha256=m.sha(prior)),new_reports=entries,main_only_test_execution=True,
        main_adjustments=['R309 fused hit/combine candidate requires multi-token decode; excluded from current T1 diagnostic.',
                          'R310 mean-row tile selector remains conditional and unimplemented; histogram/critical-path evidence needed.',
                          'R310 proposed8K model timing conflicts with user minimum32K. Kernel-only8K fixtures are allowed; all model comparisons require>=32768 input.']))
    text="""<!-- SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 yayoi -->
<!-- SPDX-License-Identifier: LGPL-3.0-or-later -->

# Pristine XeStrata update and official server integration

XeStrata advanced from da3d426 to b9f00e9 during finalization. Its engine identifies
as xe0.1.43 and integrates official v0.1.43 at `7695859`. The independent ghq
worktree is unchanged in tracked source. Necessary official server imports are
integrated at 17879c7: reasoning reserve/loop detection, held-tool SSE keepalive,
safe activity observation, opt-in replicas, resource admission and child-only
Linux CPU affinity. The selected engine inference implementation is preserved.
Server regression: 611 pass and 11 existing skips; setup: 47 pass.

Both new Xe free and contrib-llvm executables build with source LLVM7.1.1.
Each runs nine selected host CTests: eight pass and the AVX-512-only test skips
on Ryzen5600X. The new diagnostic controller's parser, pending rejection,
owned-process and normalQUIT CPU fixtures pass. The first artifact lints failed
on Markdown/hash formatting and duplicate escaped patch licensing; their failed
statuses are preserved. Typed hashes and compact duplicate-patch metadata fix
those renderings; no lint rule or runtime assertion was suppressed.

The new free executable passes same-provider integer GPU health and a 44.38s
startup. One source-controlled32768-input/16-output diagnostic completes with
prefill97544.6ms (335.928t/s), decode2214.8ms (7.224t/s), normalQUIT, empty owned
sessions, unchanged boot, no new driver fault/dump and no runtime error. Actual
settings: batched8192 prompt,144 expert slots/281MiB, pool5, PCIe fraction0,
int8 KV,32768 resident cells, physical262144 context, noMTP or batch.
Level Zero validation and tracing are enabled; this is not an optimal-speed run.
See exact individual DONE/PP/LP5, device/provider/library/source/fixture pins,
actualINFO, commands/environment, normal closure and fault evidence in receipts.

The same token input is SHA-identical to the previous da3d426 diagnostic. The
first eight generated token IDs match, then the ninth differs; reported LP5
also differs. Completion/finite-output/fault checks pass, but numerical equivalence
and model-quality preservation are not established. The historical da sample
(217.612prefill,10.411decode t/s) is retained as a single diagnostic reference,
not a ranking against this run or the curated engine. No new Xe inference port
is adopted from these numbers. Matched settings, repeated decode samples and
numerical/quality checks are needed before choosing either stage's implementation.

R306's non-atomic control polling applies to unrestricted one-shot session
execution. Main and R308 trace the selected ordinary serve return and forced
segmented verifier: compute completion precedes CPU reads, and copy completion
precedes next-segment launch. Resident graphs and the new interop copy stream
are explicitly disabled; noMTP, batches or pipelines enter the route. This
bounded source/runtime result does not qualify every engine path. R309's new
fusion requires multi-token windows. R310's mean-row MMQ selector is a future
conditional candidate, requiring route/histogram/parity evidence. Every model
comparison remains at least32768 input;8K refers only to kernel fixtures/chunks.

The first new health wrapper failed on the stats JSON key before any integer
probe/model launch: stats reports device_index and pci_bdf, not device_id. The
new wrapper checks both actual index and BDF; the original failure remains a
failure. This was not a GPU hang. No reset, unbind or service mutation occurred.

Original unpatched official v0.1.43 32K results and curated inference timings
remain historical. The official setup-default/parameter-optimized TODO, full
physical262144-input verification, RESTORE and whole-model quality remain open.
Only free whole-model GPU execution is qualified here; contrib-llvm was built
and host-tested. Compact evidence is committed; redundant closed logs and the
successful full license inventory are retired with a path/hash/reason manifest.
"""
    (F/'REPORT.md').write_text(text)
    candidates=[]
    for p,x in originals:
        for f in (p.parent/'commands').glob('*'):
            if f.is_file() and f.suffix in ['.stdout','.stderr']:
                candidates.append((f,'Closed duplicate command log; compact outcomes/diagnostics/protocol and original hash metadata retained.'))
    inventory=B/'main-current-xe-b9-publication-reuse-diagnosis-root-v1/record.json'
    candidates.append((inventory,'Resolved license investigation full inventory; exact original status/commands, noncompliant paths and summary retained in committed compact receipt.'))
    manifest=dict(owner='Main',lock=str(B/'owned-v0141-measurement.lock'),active_runs_untouched=True,
                  all_original_owned_commands_closed=True,original_statuses_unchanged=True,
                  preserved=[str(model_path.parent/'tokens.txt'),str(B/'clean64k-task-fixture-root-r3/coding-review-65536-tokens.txt')],
                  deletions=[dict(**pin(p),reason=reason) for p,reason in candidates],
                  necessary_private_receipts=dict(consumer='Exact source/build/controller qualification identities and future32K numerical comparison',
                                                  byte_budget=4<<20,next_review='Next benchmark or numerical qualification boundary; retarget to committed compact identities before retirement.'))
    dump(F/'closed-log-retention.json',manifest)
    for p,reason in candidates:
        p.unlink()
    manifest.update(deleted_files=len(candidates),deleted_logical_bytes=sum(v['bytes'] for v in manifest['deletions']),verified_absent=all(not p.exists() for p,_ in candidates))
    remaining=sum(p.stat().st_size for p,_ in originals if p.exists())
    assert remaining<=manifest['necessary_private_receipts']['byte_budget']
    manifest['necessary_private_receipts']['actual_bytes']=remaining
    dump(F/'closed-log-retention.json',manifest)
    dump(derivation_path,d)
    print(json.dumps(dict(sample=q['sample'],numerical_equivalence=q['reported_token_LP5_equivalence'],
                          deleted_files=manifest['deleted_files'],deleted_bytes=manifest['deleted_logical_bytes'],
                          necessary_private_receipt_bytes=remaining)))
